I recently spent three weeks in Koh Samui and needed to pre-order two different sizes of contact lenses before arriving. After reaching out to multiple optical shops, Piyapon Optical Samui stood out as the only one that responded quickly and helpfully.

I contacted the shop via WhatsApp, and the owner, Mr. Golf, was incredibly responsive and professional. He didn’t even ask for payment in advance—he simply confirmed my arrival date and trusted that I would visit the shop once I arrived.

Even though one of the lens sizes wasn't available in-store, Mr. Golf went out of his way to arrange it before my arrival. What impressed me the most was that when I contacted him after arriving in Koh Samui, he insisted on personally delivering the lenses to my hotel, so I didn’t have to make the trip to his shop. That level of customer service is rare and truly appreciated.

Mr. Golf is not only reliable and trustworthy but also genuinely cares about his customers. If you're in need of optical services in Koh Samui, I highly recommend visiting or contacting Piyapon Optical Samui.

Thank you very much, Mr. Golf, for your outstanding help and kindness!
